title: Switzerland's BACS says five cyberattacks used AI agents, four compromised systems, per Reuters and The420
date_note: BACS's statement is dated by the pages' publication day, 26 November; the attacks happened 'in the past few days'.
summary: Switzerland's Federal Office for Cybersecurity (BACS) said five cyberattacks in the past few days used AI agents against companies and critical infrastructure operators, Reuters reports. Four of the five compromised computer systems. Three targets were critical infrastructure operators, which Swiss broadcaster SRF said were electricity, water and telecommunications providers. BACS did not say who was behind the attacks.
plain: Swiss authorities say five recent attacks used AI agents and four of them compromised systems. Three targets ran critical infrastructure. The attackers are not named.
exec: Per Reuters, Swiss authorities say AI agents were used in five attacks, four successful, three on critical infrastructure operators.
action: The Swiss National Cyber Security Centre, per The420, recommends reducing the number of systems directly reachable from the internet and protecting remote access with multi-factor authentication or passkeys.
geo_basis: agency: BACS, the Swiss federal cybersecurity office that disclosed the cases; victims not named

sources.name: Global Banking and Finance Review (Reuters): AI agents used in five cyber attacks in Switzerland, government says
The420.in: Switzerland Confirms Five AI-Powered Cyberattacks, Four Successfully Breach Computer Systems

validation.note: Global Banking and Finance relays Reuters and The420 relays the BACS/SRF reporting; both rest on one BACS statement and BACS's own page was not read.
